name: pr-comment
instruction: This is feedback on a pull request. Decide whether it names a concrete, actionable change — a named file, a described defect, a specific request — or whether it is discussion. Actionable feedback with a clear scope is action 'fix'. Discussion, praise and questions are 'watch' or 'close'.
filter_instruction: Run only when a comment is created on a pull request (not a plain issue) and asks for a change to the code. Skip edits and deletions of comments, skip comments from bots and from CI, skip approvals and 'LGTM', and skip comments that only ask a question about intent.
